verdict.rationale: Buzz puts AI agents inside the workspace. You @mention them, they reply in-channel, and they can search months of history and surface relevant threads. A Desktop-bundled managed agent and Block's own agent runtime ship with the product. However, the evidence describes agents answering from history, not a dedicated feature that proactively produces insights or suggestions from your data, and the agents depend on an LLM you configure. Missing for 10: documented proactive insight/suggestion features, examples of analysis or summaries over workspace data, hands-on corroboration of answer quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Agents search six months of history and post the threads, not vibes.
The harness listens for @mentions on the relay, prompts your agent, and the agent replies using the Buzz CLI.
Answers from harness-seeded cold memory without the value appearing in channel history
